teaser: Brighton put five past Coventry and Leeds hammered Newcastle, but the goals dried up everywhere else - three goalless draws and a **0-0** at Anfield. If you didn't own **Groß**, you're behind.
fullWriteup:
**Coventry 0-5 Brighton** was the result of the week and it dragged a chunk of the top ten with it. **Groß** led everything with **17 points**, and Dunk (12) and De Cuyper (11) cashed in at the back. Elsewhere, Leeds' **4-1** over Newcastle handed Bogle **15 points** from £4.5m, and Ipswich won at Selhurst **3-2** with Davis on 14 and Emersonn on 12. Arsenal's **2-0** at Sunderland gave Raya a clean sheet and **14 points**.

The flat side of the gameweek was everything else. Liverpool 0-0 Fulham, Tottenham 0-0 Everton, and United 0-1 City - three low-scoring fixtures involving premium assets who gave you very little. Bournemouth 2-2 Brentford at least produced Schade on **15 points**, and Chelsea's 2-2 with Hull got João Pedro to 12 alongside Belloumi's 13 on the other side.

Price moves have been mostly one-way traffic after the deadline. Aston Villa's losing side took hits across Onana, Garnacho and Madjo, all down £0.1m, and Arsenal saw drops for Madueke, Zubimendi and Bruno G. despite the clean sheet. Only **Havertz** (£7.6m) and Tavernier (£6.1m) went the other way.
